learning_outcomes.text: Students know selected basics and concepts of computer science. They understand technical backgrounds of the many information technology systems used in professional everyday life. They can name tools and solutions for problems.

Students understand the different boundary conditions for analyzing data processing problems. They can identify suitable processes and develop appropriate applications with regard to technical challenges, and discuss societal implications.

Students are able to apply computer science tools and systems to solve engineering problems. They can evaluate computer-aided methods in terms of efficiency and security. They can solve simple problems using computer-aided tools.

syllabus_topics: Computer-Hardware, the binary system as a basis for computer technology
Operating systems, software, file systems and processes
Querying structured data using database technology
Data input and output, reading and writing files
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a term paper of 5-10 pages, including the implementation of a program in a higher programming language as a solution to a specific problem.
